text:
deploybot: Rollout v2.18.0 slot 11 paused automatically: repeated 504/503 observed from eu-control-plane after cert validation failures. Quarantine triggered at 04:12 UTC.
rachel: ack. what regions are affected and how much traffic is impacted?
marc: eu-west1 and eu-central show spikes, ~10% of EU traffic. traces show TLS handshake failures during token fetch. looks like a cert chain issue after rotation.
ops-oncall: investigating cert chain and CA trust on token-proxy; suspect expired intermediate cert pushed earlier today. ETA 25m to rollback cert or re-issue.
release-manager: do NOT auto-rollback the application. pin the release to prevent a half-deploy and notify customers. deploy-admin can you pin and tag this incident?
deploy-admin: pinning v2.18.0 on slot 11 now: `deployctl pin --svc inference-api --ver v2.18.0 --slot 11 --reason "INC-8722 cert-chain"`
deploybot: Pin recorded. Rollout frozen for slot 11; subsequent slots paused. Canary traffic drained to last-known-good.
support: queued a status update draft for customers: short notice about delay in EU rollouts due to a control-plane certificate issue; will update once we have reschedule time.
amelia: creating a hotfix branch in case we need to revert a related config: `hotfix/certchain-backout-2026-03-21`. prepping rollback steps.
marc: here's the rollback command (dry-run prepared for SRE):
```
# rollback to v2.17.9
deployctl rollback --service inference-api --from-version v2.18.0 --to-version v2.17.9 --reason "INC-8722"
```
ops-oncall: mitigation path: revert intermediate cert push on token-proxy and restart proxy fleet. performing revert now; monitoring.
incident-bot: INC-8722 created: eu control-plane TLS failures; mitigation in progress. Next update in 10m.
release-manager: proposed plan: keep the pin, reschedule remaining slots to the next maintenance window 2026-03-22 01:00-03:00 UTC. suggested next attempt 2026-03-22T01:15:00Z with a 3% early canary at 01:00. leave slot 11 quarantined until post-canary verification.
rachel: agree with reschedule. we should also add a short rollback-readiness checklist to the release doc (commands, hotfix branch, owners).
deploy-admin: annotated deploy ticket with `hold/INC-8722` tag, added checklist, and assigned owners: @amelia for hotfix, @marc for rollback exec, @support for customer comms.
deploybot: Noted. Next scheduled retry for slot 12 moved to 2026-03-22T01:00:00Z (3% canary). slot 11 remains quarantined.
ops-oncall: revert applied, proxy restarts succeeding; error rates falling back toward baseline over last 8m. recommending we keep pin and run the 01:00 micro-canary. do not auto-unquarantine slot 11.
amelia: validated hotfix branch can be applied without schema changes. rollback dry-run passed in staging.
marc: if post-canary metrics show no regressions, we resume full rollout in the 01:15 window. if metrics degrade, execute rollback command and coordinate hotfix. final signoff here required before rollback. :eyes: 
release-manager: will update release notes and status page with reschedule time and INC-8722 link. drafting customer-friendly blurb and internal changelog entry.
support: customer blurb ready for review: "EU rollouts for v2.18.0 delayed due to a control-plane certificate issue (INC-8722). We plan a small verification canary on 2026-03-22 01:00 UTC and will resume the rollout at ~01:15 UTC after validation."
ops-oncall: metrics stable for 12m; go/no-go will be published at 00:45 UTC for the 01:00 canary.
rachel: thanks. please post the final go/no-go here. also add a short postmortem point in the release doc after the canary: root cause, decision to pin rather than rollback immediately, actions taken, and next steps.
release-manager: noted. I'll merge the release doc after canary success and close the loop. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
